execute as @s[tag=!chat1, scores={praat=5..6}] at @s run say I know you're in there.
execute as @s[tag=b_stranger, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say I just needed to see you.
execute as @s[tag=b_watched, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say I let myself in. I hope that's alright.
execute as @s[tag=b_familiar, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say I've been waiting for you to get back.
execute as @s[tag=b_obsessed, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say I can't stay away. I've tried.
execute as @s[tag=b_stranger, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say You never answer when I knock.
execute as @s[tag=b_watched, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say I tried knocking. You didn't answer. Again.
execute as @s[tag=b_familiar, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say You always take so long to come home.
execute as @s[tag=b_obsessed, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say Don't be upset. I just missed you.
execute as @s[tag=b_stranger, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say Don't mind me.
execute as @s[tag=b_watched, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say I won't touch anything important.
execute as @s[tag=b_familiar, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say I tidied up a little while you were out.
execute as @s[tag=b_obsessed, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say I tidied up. You're welcome.
execute as @s[tag=b_stranger, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say I know every corner of this place.
execute as @s[tag=b_watched, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say I know where you keep everything.
execute as @s[tag=b_familiar, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say I know this place better than you do now.
execute as @s[tag=b_obsessed, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say This place feels empty without you in it.
execute as @s[tag=b_stranger, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say Everything here smells like you.
execute as @s[tag=b_watched, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say I've been in here before. You never noticed.
execute as @s[tag=b_familiar, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say It smells like you in here. I don't mind at all.
execute as @s[tag=b_obsessed, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say I'll always come back here. You know that.
execute as @s[tag=b_stranger, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say You should really lock your door.
execute as @s[tag=b_watched, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say You should hide your key somewhere better.
execute as @s[tag=b_familiar, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say I'll be gone before you notice. Probably.
execute as @s[tag=b_obsessed, tag=!chat2, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say I just needed to be somewhere that felt like you.

execute as @s[scores={dash=7, praat=2}, tag=!yell] at @s run say Fine. We do this your way.
execute as @s[scores={dash=7, praat=3}, tag=!yell] at @s run say Don't run from me.
execute as @s[scores={dash=7, praat=4}, tag=!yell] at @s run say I gave you every chance.
execute as @s[scores={dash=7, praat=5}, tag=!yell] at @s run say You could have just let me in.
execute as @s[scores={dash=7, praat=6}, tag=!yell] at @s run say I didn't want this.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say You hurt me. After everything.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say I just wanted to be close to you.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say You'll regret pushing me away.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say That... actually hurt.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say After everything I've done for you.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say You're mine.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7b, tag=b_familiar, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say I trusted you.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7b, tag=b_familiar, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say Was any of it real to you?
execute as @s[tag=!chat7b, tag=b_obsessed, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say You don't get to do this to me.
execute as @s[tag=!chat7b, tag=b_obsessed, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say After everything. After ALL of it.

execute as @s[tag=!chat3, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say This is what you made happen.

execute as @s[tag=!chat4, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say Such beautiful things you keep...
execute as @s[tag=!chat4, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say I'll take something to remember you by.
execute as @s[tag=!chat4, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say You won't miss it.
execute as @s[tag=!chat4, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say A little piece of you. Just for me.
execute as @s[tag=!chat4, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say You keep the most interesting secrets.
execute as @s[tag=!chat4, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say I knew you were hiding something.
execute as @s[tag=!chat5, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say I'll be back. I always come back.
execute as @s[tag=!chat5, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say Sleep well.
execute as @s[tag=!chat5, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say Don't change anything. I like it how it is.
execute as @s[tag=!chat5, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say You didn't even notice I was here.
execute as @s[tag=!chat5, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say A souvenir.
execute as @s[tag=!chat5, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say I only ever needed one thing.
execute as @s[tag=!chat6, scores={praat=1}] at @s run say I know your schedule better than you do.
execute as @s[tag=!chat6, scores={praat=2}] at @s run say I'll be waiting when you get back.
execute as @s[tag=!chat6, scores={praat=3}] at @s run say You really should lock your door.
execute as @s[tag=!chat6, scores={praat=4}] at @s run say The night is better. Quieter. Just us.
execute as @s[tag=!chat6, scores={praat=5}] at @s run say I'd rather be nowhere else.
execute as @s[tag=!chat6, scores={praat=6}] at @s run say I could watch you forever.
